APTED tree edit distance

2 · Validate
Zod · extension · 256 KB · 5000 lines
UTF-8 strict decode · NUL rejection

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · Store
SHA-256 content hash
object to the store, Submission to Mongo
status: queued

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · Enqueue
BullMQ job on Redis, debounced by job id,
so sixty uploads at a deadline
collapse into a few runs
